newsitem.title: USA: CKE sees fiscal year revenues of $613 mln.
newsitem.headline: CKE sees fiscal year revenues of $613 mln.

text.p: CKE Restaurants Inc expects revenues of $613 million for the fiscal year ending January 27, 1997, up 32 percent over the prior fiscal year.

It said same-store sales for its Carl's Jr chain grew an estimated 10.5 percent in the fourth quarter, up an estimated 10.7 percent for the fiscal year. Final fiscal year-end results are tentatively scheduled to be announced the week of March 17, 1997.
CKE also said Carl Strunk was named executive vice president, chief financial officer and Andrew Puzder has been named executive vice president, general counsel.

Strunk also serves as executive vice president, chief financial officer for Fidelity National Financial Inc in Irvine, Calif. Puzder serves as executive vice president, general counsel for Fidelity National Financial.
